vrml.40:
#X3D V4.1 utf8 X_ITE V16.5.0

PROFILE Interchange

COMPONENT EnvironmentalSensor : 3
COMPONENT PointingDeviceSensor : 1
COMPONENT Scripting : 1
COMPONENT Sound : 3
COMPONENT Text : 2

DEF V Viewpoint {
  position 7.4 0 37
}

Sound {
  location 1 0 -2
  direction 0.6 0 -0.8
  minBack 2
  minFront 8
  maxBack 6
  maxFront 20
  source DEF O AudioClip {
    url "media/tone48k-stereo.wav"
    loop TRUE
    startTime 946684800.048
  }
}

DEF T TimeSensor {
  cycleInterval 0.5
  loop TRUE
}

DEF S Script {
  inputOnly      SFTime  set_time
  outputOnly     SFTime  start
  initializeOnly SFInt32 n 49

  url "javascript:
function set_time (value) { if (++ n === 12) start = value; }
"
}

DEF M Script {
  inputOnly      SFTime  set_time
  outputOnly     SFVec3f p
  initializeOnly SFInt32 n 49

  url "javascript:
function set_time (value) { ++ n; if (n > 12) p = new SFVec3f (0.2 * (n - 12), 0, 1.0 * (n - 12)); }
"
}

ROUTE T.time TO S.set_time
ROUTE S.start TO O.set_startTime
ROUTE T.time TO M.set_time
ROUTE M.p TO V.set_position
